rationale: This additive post-Mission-5 Experience integration implements existing presentation and contract-consumption duties without changing constitutional meaning. It mounts a read-only hosted command directory, makes every mutation retain its exact action and session gate, consumes transient drafts before transport while keeping exact idempotent retry material only in private component state, distinguishes verified Realtime voice from governed text and browser-speech fallback, and exposes Runtime-returned proof, receipt, Mission, and Replay identities next to successful results. Operational Replay remains a passive generic projection selected through canonical Mission, receipt, or Replay routes with stale-request guards. Portable cross-client unavailability now requires an enumerated Runtime-contract limitation proof; source absence is not accepted as capability evidence. Browser persistence is reduced to the Light, Dark, or System color-mode preference. The change creates no Runtime truth, Authority, completion claim, deployment, production-readiness claim, Mission 6 work, or mutation of accepted Mission history and receipts.
